fork-shares-offset.about: A child forked after open shares the file offset: its write and the parent's follow each other.

dup-shares-offset.about: dup gives a second fd on the same open file description, with one offset.

unlink-while-open.about: A file unlinked while open can still be read through the open fd; the name is gone.

hard-link.about: A hard link is a second name for one inode: writes show through both, and it survives unlinking the first.

rename-replaces.about: rename moves a name onto another, replacing what was there.

pipe-eof-after-close.about: A pipe's reader sees end of file once every write end is closed.

pipe-open-write-end.about: A parent that keeps its own copy of the write end open leaves the reader waiting for ever.

redirect-then-dup.about: > f 2>&1: both outputs go to the file.

dup-then-redirect.about: 2>&1 > f: stderr goes where stdout was, the terminal; only stdout goes to the file.

sigpipe.about: Writing to a pipe whose read end is closed kills the writer with SIGPIPE.

wait-status.about: wait gives the parent its child's exit status.
